borrowings: query { perp { borrowings { marketId price isOpen visible minLeverage maxLeverage minPositionSizeUSD openFeePct closeFeePct baseToken { id symbol name } quoteToken { symbol } collateralToken { id symbol } } } }
borrowing: query($market:Int!, $collateral:Int!) { perp { borrowing(marketId:$market,collateralId:$collateral) { marketId isOpen minLeverage maxLeverage collateralToken { id symbol } } } }
tokenPricesUsd: query { oracle { tokenPricesUsd(limit: 100) { priceUsd token { id symbol name } lastUpdatedBlock { block block_ts } } } }
trades: query($trader:String!) { perp { trades(where:{trader:$trader,isOpen:true}, limit:100) { id trader isOpen isLong tradeType collateralAmount leverage openPrice tp sl state { liquidationPrice pnlCollateral pnlPct positionValue } perpBorrowing { marketId baseToken { symbol } collateralToken { symbol } } } } }
trade: query($trader:String!, $id:Int!) { perp { trade(trader:$trader,id:$id) { id trader isOpen tradeType collateralAmount leverage perpBorrowing { marketId collateralToken { id symbol } } } } }
tradeHistory: query($trader:String!) { perp { tradeHistory(where:{trader:$trader}, limit:50, order_desc:true) { id intentKey tradeChangeType txHash evmTxHash block { block block_ts } trade { id trader } } } }
userIntents: query($user:String!, $key:String) { userIntents(where:{user:$user, intentKey:$key}, limit:50) { intentKey kind lifecycleStep execActor evmAddress nibiAddress txHash execBlock execBlockTs errorCode errorMsg } }
recordUserIntent: mutation($input:RecordUserIntentInput!) { recordUserIntent(input:$input) { intentKey kind lifecycleStep execActor evmAddress txHash errorCode errorMsg } }
ws:userBalances: subscription($user:String!) { userBalances(where:{user:$user}) { amount usd_value token_info { name symbol decimals type } } }
ws:perpTrades: subscription($user:String!) { perpTrades(where:{trader:$user}) { id trader isOpen isLong tradeType leverage openPrice tp sl } }
ws:tokenPricesUsd: subscription($id:Int!) { tokenPricesUsd(where:{tokenId:$id}) { priceUsd token { id symbol } lastUpdatedBlock { block block_ts } } }
waitUserIntents: query($user:String!, $key:String, $includeAction:Boolean! = false) { userIntents(where:{user:$user, intentKey:$key}, limit:50) { intentKey kind body @include(if:$includeAction) lifecycleStep execActor evmAddress nibiAddress txHash execBlock execBlockTs errorCode errorMsg } }
ws:userBalancesWithBlock: subscription($user:String!) { userBalances(where:{user:$user}) { amount usd_value lastUpdatedBlock token_info { name symbol decimals type } } }
